title: Estée Lauder Companies plans voluntary redundancies in France as part of ‘Beauty Reimagined’ turnaround
summary: The beauty giant first announced its ‘Profit Recovery and Growth Plan’ (PRGP) in November 2023 to boost flagging sales, which was expanded in February 2025 under the banner, ‘Beauty Reimagined’

extraction.key_fact: 에스티 로더 컴퍼니즈가 사업 재정비 계획의 하나로 프랑스에서 희망퇴직을 추진한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Estée Lauder Companies plans voluntary redundancies in France as part of ‘Beauty Reimagined’ turnaround
